title: Kites in the Wind
retell: What went wrong with the blue kite, and how did Kate and Mike fix it?

pages.text: It is a fine day. Kate and Mike have kites.
Kate has a pink kite with a long tail.
Mike has a blue kite like a snake.
They run up the hill and let the kites go.
Up, up, up! The kites ride on the wind.
Then the wind stops. The blue kite dives to the ground.
Kate spots it. She runs and grabs the line.
Kate and Mike tie the kites side by side.
Now the kites rise up as one.
Kate and Mike smile. It is the best kite day of all!

questions.q: Why did they tie the kites side by side?
